resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Firelookout.com say built about 1939; the Oregon lookouts page and the 1994 inventory table appear to say 1941. The Oregon page's panorama photos of September 5, 1936 predate both dates and are unexplained. The story reports the disagreement and does not choose.

The register says removed in 1962; Firelookout.com and the Oregon lookouts page say destroyed in 1962 (the Oregon page gives October 12, 1962 and the Columbus Day storm). The year agrees; the verb differs.

notes_for_editor: Construction year conflict (about 1939 vs 1941) is unresolved. The 1994 Atwood inventory is OCR text: the Cleopatra row's years (1941/1962) are inferred from the table layout, so check the scanned page before relying on them. The Oregon lookouts 1936 panorama date predates both build dates; it may refer to an earlier structure, which the sources do not explain. KS Wild is an advocacy group; used only for trail routes and mining stakes, and its article does not mention the lookout. No source gives the site's present condition or public access, so facts.access is omitted. Staffing status 'staffed' with as_of 1941 refers to that season only.
